overview: Spruce Grove grew 10.4 per cent between 2016 and 2021 to 37,645 residents in 14,273 occupied homes, well ahead of the Alberta rate. Its retailers also serve a primary trading area much larger than the city itself, reaching into the surrounding rural region west of Edmonton.

Competition is real but not crowded, and major projects such as the Westwind development are adding commercial space. Businesses that become known across the wider trading area, not only inside city limits, have the most room to grow.
